newsitem.title: USA: Disney names Marcotte CFO of unit.
newsitem.headline: Disney names Marcotte CFO of unit.

text.p: Walt Disney Co Thursday named Gary Marcotte vice president and chief financial officer of Disney Regional Entertainment.

In a statement, Disney said Marcotte will be responsible for all of Disney Regional Entertainment's financial affairs and business development planning. Disney Regional is a new division that will develop and launch several location-based entertainment businesses throughout the United States and around the world.
The first venture, a community playsite called Club Disney, will open in February 1997 in the Los Angeles area.
Marcotte joined Disney in 1989 and was named vice president, international accounting and finance, in 1995.
